description_expanded: Overview5.0(18 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Condo! * Steps to the Heated Community Pool and Hot Tub* Directly across 30A to Deeded Beach Access* Spacious Balcony w/ Lake, Pool and partial Gulf views* Gulf Place Town Center at Your Doorstep* Enjoy top-notch community amenities including 3 pools, a hot tub, tennis courts, shuffleboard, and pickleball courts – perfect for relaxation and recreation!* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Unique cafes, pizzerias, local shops, and boutiques next door * BBQ Grill areas, outdoor amphitheater, bike rentals, and more! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *Due to construction at this community's Caribbean building, the Caribbean pool and hot tub on the campus will be shut down 11/01-03/31/2027. The Cabanas and Park Pool will be heated for the fall and winter season, and we encourage people to visit the Park Pool as it is larger than the Cabanas. CABANAS POOL WILL REMAIN OPEN!** NO smoking in the unit or on the balcony; only in designated smoking areas behind the elevator on the ground floor. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance by guests and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, decibel meters, and video surveillance, including the front door.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Sun Stone is a beautifully updated 1-bedroom + enclosed hallway bunk room, 1.5-bath condo located in Gulf Place Cabanas, offering comfortable accommodations for up to 6 guests. The spacious living area features a comfortable queen sleeper sofa and opens to the community grounds, while the fully equipped kitchen makes preparing meals easy. The master bedroom offers a king-size bed and new Smart TV, while the enclosed hallway bunk room features two twin beds—perfect for the kids. This unit is also located just outside the door of the facility laundry room adding convenience to your stay! Located in the heart of Gulf Place, this vibrant coastal community offers three pools, hot tubs, tennis courts, shuffleboard, BBQ areas, and a large outdoor amphitheater. Enjoy beach access directly across the street, plus easy access to nearby restaurants, cafes, boutiques, live music, and fire pits. Everything you need for the perfect 30A getaway is right outside your door!The Bed Setup: Bedroom: King Bed Hallway: Twin Bunks Living Room: Queen Sofa SleeperArea Attractions: The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A is comprised of 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique from all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music and a laid-back atmosphere. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
